title: Every Kid Gets a Cloud. Mine Hasn't Opened in Ten Years. (Part 1)
summary: Fold and Nell try to save his ten-year cloud from the king, and three answering thunderclaps frighten the royal dragon.
frame_0: Fold stands in a puddle beneath a dark rain cloud in the daylight square. The wolf and golden dragon have their own age plates, with the king's crossbow rolling behind the children.
package_differences: The corner handle appears throughout the story. The supplied five-second Flashloop ending retains its original picture and audio.
review_note: The complete mix was checked by decoded signal measurements and stereo meters, including mono speech and the CTA. Direct listening was unavailable in this review.
